references.text: The account of Rachel giving birth to Benjamin, her death and burial near Ephrath (Bethlehem) – the primary parallel to Jacob's recollection here
God blessed Jacob when he came from Paddan-Aram, as Jacob refers to in 48:7
Samuel mentions Rachel's tomb at Benjamin's border, confirming the location of her burial site
Rachel is mentioned in connection with Bethlehem, linking the Rachel tradition to this place
Jacob returned safely from Paddan-Aram to the land of Canaan, providing background for the journey he describes
The direct account of the event referred to in the source verse.
The birth narrative that immediately preceded the death and burial mentioned in the source verse.
